text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—New Year prayers. First, let's pay our 
Hatsumode visit to pray for success and 
great leaps forward in the Senior Year.
choice_data_list: Let's go to the shrine, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry... I really want to go, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My body just won't move today~. It's 
freezin' cold, see... My nose wouldn't 
stop runnin' this mornin' either~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Please have mercy, have mercy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She seemed extraordinarily weak to the 
cold. At this rate, even going for New 
Year's shrine visit was out of the 
question.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, right! I just had a wonderful idea. 
If we can't go meet God...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Couldn't God come over to us instead? 
Trainer, you play the role of God."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've got an outfit 
all ready to go. A divine-looking costume 
that I spent ages knit-knitting together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was forcibly made to change clothes. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, it suits you so well... You look 
just like Lord Hotei.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now you can pray to it right from your 
room, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They made me cosplay as a god. Still... it 
actually doesn't feel half bad.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Have you also awakened? To the 
sheer joy of donning stage attire!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems that deep down, I may have been 
inspired by T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Blessings upon you, blessings upon you... 
By the way~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Can God do anything God-like, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: We can put out New Year's merch!
We can put out New Year's merch!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, isn't that amazing! Well, color me 
surprised~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I blurted that out in the heat of the 
moment. Still, now that I've said it, I 
have to come up with something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, what are you gonna bring out for me, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's item... After much thought, I 
have decided to bestow this upon you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, a meat bun! It's a piping hot meat 
bun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*munch munch munch*... So delicious, so 
grateful for this. Warms you right up from 
the bottom of your stomach, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her eat with such delight, a 
thought crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: Want a bean paste bun too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, a sweet bean bun...! If I had to 
pick, I actually prefer those~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Still, do you really have one?
choice_data_list: There are, if you go buy them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An omnipotent God can get any steamed bun 
they want just by going to a convenience 
store.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~, even a steamed bean bun~. Thank 
you so, so much, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're so kind, Trainer, you're starting 
to look like a real god to meee.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute's stomach was 
satisfied. The convenience store clerk 
laughed at me, but... as long as she's 
this happy, it's well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, a wand of good fortune...! God 
truly possesses wonderful things.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Now, who would like something like 
this...? Ah, right. Let's invite that girl 
over and spend some time together."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan, dear Ricky-chan, is this what 
you call "Feng Shui power"?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Zzz-zap, time stand still~. Kagami mochi, 
crack open~. And then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hold tight, roasted soybean flour, don't 
blow away if I sneeze~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's not it~. Feng shui power isn't 
really like that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you look like you're having fun, 
Acute-san☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there might be a misunderstanding 
about feng shui. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to any of that, Wonder 
Acute waved her staff around, relishing 
the feeling of omnipotence.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, a diary...! With this, I'll be able 
to write down this year's goals.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, if we make a proper schedule, 
you're sure to become stronger~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What I need to write down is... the date 
of the race, and then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Were we out of soy sauce? Soy sauce... 
check. And then value-pack ham..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even shopping plans are jotted down. 
Writing everything down should help keep 
important things from slipping through the 
cracks.
